name: Blade Ball
desc:
⚡  In this game of focus, timing, and strategy, your skill is tested as a deflectable homing ball hunts players with increasing speed. But there's more than what meets the eye.

🔥  Gain new abilities and upgrade them to compliment your playstyle. Rise through the ranks by mastering your skill, and stand out with a variety of iconic weapon skins and finisher effects.

🏆 Shoot for the leaderboard or play casually! The choice is yours.
 
CONTROLS:
BLOCK - F/R1/Tap Screen/Tap UI Button/Left Click
ABILITY - Q/ButtonX/Tap UI Button/Right Click
SHIFTLOCK - Shift/Button-Y/Tap UI Button
EMOTE - R/L1/Tap UI Button

scripts.title: Script Op And  Event Auto Parry
scripts.features:
1. Blade Ball script is a versatile script that allows you to control a virtual blade ball in a 3D environment.
2. The script offers various features to manipulate the blade ball, such as changing its size, color, and texture.
3. It includes realistic physics simulations, enabling the blade ball to roll, bounce, and interact with other objects in the virtual environment.
4. The script offers intuitive controls for navigating and controlling the blade ball, including the ability to move forward, backward, and sideways.
5. It allows you to set the blade ball's initial position and orientation, giving you full control over its starting position in the environment.
6. The script includes collision detection, ensuring that the blade ball can interact with other objects and surfaces in the environment.
7. It provides options to adjust the friction and bounciness of the blade ball, allowing you to customize its behavior and movement.
8. The script includes audio effects, providing realistic sound effects for rolling, bouncing, and colliding with other objects.
9. It offers smooth camera movements, allowing you to observe the blade ball's movement from different angles and perspectives.
10. The script includes a scoring system, allowing you to keep track of points or achievements as the blade ball interacts with the environment.
